Dear Contoso Ltd,

Your account has been corrected for an overbilling error. A refund of **120** has been issued for the incorrect **PLATINUM-BES9** tier applied last month. Your active plan is now **BRONZE**, as confirmed in our records. If this does not reflect your intended tier, reply to this email to discuss.

Regards,
The Support Team
